hooks.command:
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */src/*.ts|*/src/*.tsx) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && out=$(./node_modules/.bin/eslint --quiet "$f" 2>&1) || jq -n --arg c "eslint found errors in $f:
$out" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:$c}}';; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */src/*.ts|*/src/*.tsx) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && out=$(bash scripts/standards-citation-index.sh --check 2>&1) || jq -n --arg c "standards banner check failed after editing $f:
$out" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:$c}}';; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only) && if echo "$staged" | grep -q '^src/' && ! echo "$staged" | grep -q '^packages/released.json$'; then jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",additionalContext:"src changes are staged but packages/released.json is not: this repo records the package manifest with each src change. Run node packages/release.mjs --write (it rebuilds every package, a few minutes) and commit the manifest, unless this commit is docs or tests only."}}'; fi 2>/dev/null || true
